SELECT rp.permission_code AS permissionCode, COALESCE(p.permission_name, rp.permission_code) AS permissionName FROM sys_role_permission rp LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE rp.role_code = #{roleCode} ORDER BY rp.permission_code

SELECT r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, r.status AS status, r.role_type AS roleType FROM sys_role_permission rp INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = rp.role_code WHERE rp.permission_code = #{permissionCode} ORDER BY r.role_code
